exposure: gastric acid inhibitor use during pregnancy
outcome: antidepressant use (up to 1 year after childbirth)
cohort: The study included 623,871 women with a first singleton live birth in Sweden between 2006 and 2016, excluding those with a history of depression.
finding: The use of antibiotics and gastric acid inhibition drugs during pregnancy was associated with a higher risk of postpartum depression.
